literal_meaning: হাত আসা (hand comes or hand becomes accustomed)
figurative_meaning_en: to have the habit of giving or donating
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার হাত আসা, সবসময় দান করে।
দানের জন্য তার হাত আসে খুব সহজে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has a habit of giving; his hand comes easily for donations.
She is accustomed to donating; giving comes naturally to her.
note: This idiom reflects Bengali cultural emphasis on generosity and almsgiving.
